name: Riverbank
desc: Meeting, waiting, crossing - a boundary you can talk across but not step over.
tags: scenery, no humans, river, grassy bank, reeds, pebble shore, shallow water over stones, overhanging willow, ripples, current, far bank
prose: a river running past a grassy bank thick with reeds, shallow water sliding over pebbles at the near shore, a willow leaning out over the water and the far bank visible beyond
note: Turns into a lake or a pond if flow is not stated - keep ripples, current and the far bank so it stays a river with two sides. Ask for the near shore (pebbles, reeds) explicitly or the camera drifts out over open water and there is nowhere for a character to stand.
